divisions.name: Retirement
divisions.note: The candidates' votes add up to 1,607; with the 6 rejected ballots that makes 1,613, against the 1,623 total votes the report prints. The figures are stored as printed. The printed share of 47.2 per cent for Minott fits 766 votes, which would balance.
